prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Post-Setup Pet Controls Guide Screen: Add a dedicated post-setup desktop controls guide screen after home_intro demonstrating system tray access and desktop movement. (why: 3 support emails showed users struggle to control or find their pet after completing onboarding, leading to finish drop-off.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In After Pet Selection: Reorder the sign-in step to occur after pet selection so users personalize their pet before creating an account. (why: Sign_in drops 27.1% of users early before they build attachment to their pet.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Split View Path Selection Layout: Change the choose_path layout to a split view clearly distinguishing between instant quick selection and photo customization. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean time of 514s, signaling decision paralysis between paths.)
3: [adoption, copy] Custom Pet Generation Fallback Guarantee Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to reassure users that custom pet generation has automatic quality fallback protection. (why: 3 support emails mentioned custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, contributing to 68.7% conversion on adoption.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Verification Status Display: Add explicit renderer progress and desktop compatibility checks to the waiting screen. (why: 3 support emails reported pet failing to appear on desktop, while mean wait time on home step is 2336s.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Desktop Tray Notification: Enable desktop notification alert on the waiting screen when the pet desktop renderer completes initialization. (why: Mean waiting duration is over 38 minutes (2336s), leading users to lose track of desktop loading.)
6: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Quality Validation Flow: Insert a photo quality verification screen before adoption certificate generation to ensure input photos meet rendering criteria. (why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation errors or distorted results, causing drop-offs during adoption.)
